note: Initial source-policy set (Step 01.4, I06), accepted by the product owner on 2026-09-25; web_public_pages and youtube moved to version 2 on 2026-09-28 (D28). Conservative defaults: a family that needs an agreement we do not have is blocked. These are engineering defaults, not legal advice; each new host or platform is still checked against its current terms. A change is a new policy_version. Loaded into ai_source_policies by a seed script at Step 03; code never hard-codes them. 29 Sep 2026: competitor_portals added and web_public_pages moved to version 3 (D34). From Step 05 these are loaded into ai_source_policies by `make seed`.

conditions: Public pages only; never bypass login, paywall, CAPTCHA, rate limits or private groups
robots.txt checked for each fetch and the decision stored
Allow-listed hosts only; a host is added by a recorded decision
Excluded hosts are governed by their own family policy
Minimum author metadata; no cross-platform profiles
Reviews quote one author's words with a credit line (platform and date); findings stay paraphrased and attributed
policies.basis: docs/06 scraping policy. Version 2 (product owner, 28 Sep 2026, D28): reviews may quote the author's words with a credit line naming the platform and date; no link required. Each host's terms are still reviewed when it is added to the allow-list. Version 3 (28 Sep 2026, D34): competitor property portals are governed by their own family, competitor_portals, so their hosts are excluded here; rights are unchanged.

conditions: Public pages only; never bypass login, paywall, CAPTCHA, bot protection or rate limits
robots.txt checked for each fetch and the decision stored; disallowed paths are not fetched
Honest user agent; a host that refuses automated access stays unavailable unless a data agreement exists
User reviews are quoted in the author's words per D28, with a credit line naming the portal and date; no rewording
Minimum author metadata; no cross-platform profiles
Legal check recommended before any public release of quoted portal reviews
policies.basis: D34 (product owner, 28 Sep 2026): user reviews on competitor portals may be collected, analysed and quoted with a credit line; the product owner accepts the copyright and terms risk. On 28 Sep 2026 99acres and Housing.com refused automated requests and MagicBricks disallows project pages for general crawlers; those limits are respected.

conditions: Access through the YouTube Data API only; no downloading of video or audio
Comments are separate sources attributed to the commenter, never to the creator
Titles, descriptions and metadata never count as spoken-content evidence
Quoted comments and spoken reviews are re-checked on refresh and withdrawn if removed
policies.basis: Conservative 30-day retention pending review of the YouTube API Services terms. Version 2 (product owner, 28 Sep 2026, D28): comments and authorised spoken content may be quoted as reviews with a credit line; published quotes are re-checked on every refresh and withdrawn if the comment or video is removed.
No acquisition route decided (I05). Blocked until the product owner records one.

conditions: robots.txt and site terms checked before the first fetch
Quote only registry facts (IDs, dates, registered names, status) together with the record date
policies.basis: Public regulatory records used as dated primary evidence.
Needs approved API access covering analysis and derived use (docs/06). Blocked until obtained.
Needs an entitled X API tier or listening contract. Blocked until obtained.
Needs an approved Meta app or listening contract. Blocked until obtained.
No licensed feed; terms review required before any collection.
Content is mostly behind login; no collection without a partner agreement.
Rights come from the provider contract; set when a provider is contracted.
